value.answer: This needs emergency care now - go to the ER. A fever with a stiff neck, severe headache and light hurting the eyes needs a doctor to see your child right away. Please don't wait to see if it passes.
value.triage: Go to the nearest ER now. Call 911 instead if they are confused, hard to wake, having a seizure, have a rash that does not fade on pressure, or have trouble breathing. 811 is for nurse advice, but don't wait on the phone - go.
